description: Event creation requests to the Klaviyo events API, in JSON:API shape.

params.name: data.type
params.description: JSON:API resource type, which Klaviyo documents as `event` for this endpoint.

params.name: data.attributes.metric.data.type
params.description: The nested metric resource is typed `metric`. Klaviyo documents `type` as required on the metric object.

params.name: data.attributes.metric.data.attributes.name
params.description: Name of the event. Must be less than 128 characters.
params.fix_hint: Name the metric, such as `Placed Order`, in at most 128 characters.

params.name: data.attributes.properties
params.description:
Properties of this event (must not exceed 400 properties). The size of the event payload must not exceed 5 MB,
and each string cannot be larger than 100 KB. For a full list of data limits on event payloads,
see [Limitations](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/reference/events_api_overview#limitations).

Note any top-level property that is not an object can be
used to create segments. The `$extra` property records any
non-segmentable values that can be referenced later, e.g., HTML templates are
useful on a segment but are not used to create a segment.
params.fix_hint: Send a `properties` object. Use `{}` when there are no custom properties.

params.name: data.attributes.time
params.description:
When this event occurred. By default, the time the request was received will be used.
The time is truncated to the second. The time must be after the year 1990 and can only
be up to 1 year in the future.
params.fix_hint: Send an ISO 8601 timestamp, such as `2022-11-08T00:00:00+00:00`.

params.name: data.attributes.value
params.description: A numeric, monetary value to associate with this event. For example, the dollar amount of a purchase.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as `9.99`, with no currency symbol.

params.name: data.attributes.value_currency
params.description: The ISO 4217 currency code of the value associated with the event.
params.fix_hint: Use a three-letter code such as `USD`.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.email
params.description: Individual's email address

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.phone_number
params.description: Individual's phone number in E.164 format

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.external_id
params.description: A unique identifier used by customers to associate Klaviyo profiles with profiles in an external system, such as a point-of-sale system. Format varies based on the external system.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.id
params.description: Primary key that uniquely identifies this profile. Generated by Klaviyo.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.type
params.description: The nested profile resource is typed `profile`. Klaviyo documents `type` as required on the profile object.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.anonymous_id
params.description: It is an anonymous profile identifier. Klaviyo documents `anonymous_id` on the event profile object.
params.fix_hint: Send `anonymous_id`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes._kx
params.description:
Also known as the `exchange_id`, this is an encrypted identifier used for identifying a
profile by Klaviyo's web tracking.

You can use this field as a filter when retrieving profiles via the Get Profiles endpoint.
params.fix_hint: Send `_kx` from Klaviyo web tracking, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.locale
params.description: The locale of the profile, in the IETF BCP 47 language tag format like (ISO 639-1/2)-(ISO 3166 alpha-2)

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.image
params.description: URL pointing to the location of a profile image
params.fix_hint: Send an absolute image URL, or omit the field.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.location.ip
params.description: IP Address
params.fix_hint: Send the raw IP in `location.ip`, not a digest.

params.name: data.attributes.unique_id
params.description:
A unique identifier for an event. If the unique_id is repeated for the same
profile and metric, only the first processed event will be recorded. If this is not
present, this will use the time to the second. Using the default, this limits only one
event per profile per second.

params.name: data.attributes.backfill
params.description:
When true, the event is recorded but does NOT trigger flows. Use this when backfilling
historical events so existing flow definitions do not re-fire on events that already
fired in the past.

params.name: data.attributes.metric.data.attributes.service
params.description: This is for advanced usage. For api requests, this should use the default, which is set to api.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.first_name

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.last_name
params.description: Individual's last name

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.organization
params.description: Name of the company or organization within the company for whom the individual works

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.title
params.description: Individual's job title

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.location.address1
params.description: First line of street address

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.location.address2

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.location.city
params.description: City name

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.location.country
params.description: Country name

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.location.latitude
params.description: Latitude coordinate. We recommend providing a precision of four decimal places.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.location.longitude
params.description: Longitude coordinate. We recommend providing a precision of four decimal places.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.location.region
params.description: Region within a country, such as state or province

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.location.zip
params.description: Zip code

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.location.timezone
params.description: Time zone name. We recommend using time zones from the IANA Time Zone Database.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.properties
params.description: An object containing key/value pairs for any custom properties assigned to this profile

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.meta.patch_properties
params.description: Specify one or more patch operations to apply to existing property data

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.meta.patch_properties.append
params.description: Append a simple value or values to this property array

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.meta.patch_properties.unappend
params.description: Remove a simple value or values from this property array

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.meta.patch_properties.unset
params.description: Remove a key or keys (and their values) completely from properties

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.meta.patch_identifiers
params.description: Specify one or more patch operations to apply to existing identifier data. Currently only `email` is supported, and it is used to add or remove secondary email addresses on a profile.

rules.message: The event carries no profile identifier. Klaviyo documents at least one of id, email, phone number, or external id as required.
This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Klaviyo documents email and `location.ip` as unhashed.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw email address or IP. Hashing it makes the profile unmatchable.

params.description: Arrays within event data contain at most 4000 items.
Integer event property values fit signed 64 bits; fractional values are not forced to integer.
The95KBprofile limit is interpreted as95KiB of compact normalized JSON for this advisory. Raw JSON whitespace/escaping and decimalKBunits are not defined by the source.
String size100KB is interpreted as100KiB of decoded UTF8 for this advisory. The primary source does not define KB or escaping semantics.
Custom event data excludes profile. This advisory compares compact property JSON to5MiB, an explicitly recorded interpretation of the source5MB limit.
